ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Ley 10/2010, de 28 de abril, de prevención del blanqueo de capitales y de la financiación del terrorismo (as amended by Ley 13/2023, transposing Directive (EU) 2018/843); Real Decreto 304/2014, de 5 de mayo (implementing regulation establishing the Registro de Titularidades Reales, operated within the Registro Central de Entidades of the Consejo General del Notariado); Real Decreto Legislativo 1/2010, de 2 de julio (Ley de Sociedades de Capital, Articles 9, 126, 127 on corporate seat and shareholder identification).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificado Negativo de Denominación Social (Negative Name Clearance Certificate)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: No domestic apostille required for the incorporation procedure; Hague Apostille via the competent Ministry of Justice legalization office only when the certificate is presented before a foreign registry

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Escritura Pública de Constitución de Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public affiliated to the competent Colegio Notarial in the district of the registered office
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille under the 1961 Convention issued by the Consejo General del Notariado legalization office for notarial instruments; Consular Legalization through the Spanish Ministry of Foreign Affairs and the destination consulate if the receiving state is not a Hague Convention party

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Declaración de Titularidad Real (UBO Declaration and Register Filing)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Founding shareholders confirmed before the notary; filed electronically in the Registro de Titularidades Reales via the notarial network
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarized declaration; Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization only where the foreign investor bank or counterparty requires external evidentiary use

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: NIE / Foreign Investor Identity Documentation and Power of Attorney
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Oficina de Extranjería or Spanish Consulate for documents executed abroad
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille for EU and other Convention member states; Consular Legalization for non-Convention states, followed by sworn translation into Spanish

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Real Decreto Legislativo 1/2010, de 2 de julio, por el que se aprueba el texto refundido de la Ley de Sociedades de Capital (Spanish Companies Act), Articles 22–30 (incorporation), 34 (registration), 62 (minimum capital), 77–78 (paid-up capital), 102, 124, 132 (registered office and administration), and Royal Decree 1559/2012 (Mercantile Registry Regulations)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registro Mercantil Central (Central Mercantile Registry) for name certification; Registro Mercantil Provincial (Provincial Mercantile Registry) of the registered office province for deed inscription
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Escritura de Constitución (public notarial deed of incorporation) inscribed in the Mercantile Registry, supported by Form 036/037 for CIF registration at the Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: EUR 3,000 statutory minimum share capital for a Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada; capital must be fully subscribed and fully paid in cash at the date of deed execution (Article 62 and 78 LSC); the paid-up amount must be deposited in an escrow or blocked bank account in the name of the company in formation ('Sociedad en Formación') and the deposit certificate must be attached to the notarial deed
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FIRST: The founding members ratify the subscription of share capital of EUR 3,000, representing the statutory minimum, fully subscribed and fully paid up as evidenced by the escrow deposit certificate. SECOND: The share allocation schedule recorded in the subscription minutes is approved. THIRD: The registered office is fixed at [Address], [Municipality], Spain, constituting the company's corporate seat. FOURTH: [Name], identified by Passport [No.], is appointed Sole Administrator with full representation powers under the Companies Act; the Administrator may delegate within the law. FIFTH: The Administrator is instructed to execute the incorporation deed before a Spanish Notary, obtain provisional NIF, and file with the Mercantile Registry.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name Certification (Certificado Negativo de Denominación Social)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Mercantil Central (Central Mercantile Registry) through the CIRCE electronic portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit via electronic signature up to three proposed company names in priority order to the Central Mercantile Registry; the Registry verifies that no identical or confusingly similar name exists and issues the favorable 'certificación negativa' (name certificate) which is valid for 2 months (renewable) and must be presented to the Notary at deed execution.
required_dossiers: Application form for name reservation (solicitud de certificación de denominación)
Identification (DNI/passport) of the promovente (incorporator)
Draft by-laws or company purpose summary for name compatibility check
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the requested name is rejected as identical or confusingly similar, refile with alternatives; if the certificate lapses, obtain a fresh certificate before deed execution; if the Registry fails to answer within the statutory period, proceed under the silent positive resolution rule (silencio administrativo positivo) as applicable to name certification.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Escrow Deposit of Minimum Share Capital
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Authorized Spanish credit institution (regulated commercial bank) in the name of the company in formation
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a restricted deposit account (cuenta de constitución) in the name of 'Sociedad en Formación' followed by the intended corporate name; deposit the full EUR 3,000 minimum capital; obtain a bank certificate (certificado de depósito) confirming deposit, beneficiary, and non-withdrawability until registration; the deposit certificate is attached to the notarial deed.
required_dossiers: Name certificate from the Central Mercantile Registry
Identification documents of corporate founders/shareholders (DNI, NIE, or passport)
Bank deposit instructions and due diligence/AML forms (compliance with Law 10/2010)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank refuses the account for KYC reasons, select an alternate authorized credit entity and re-deposit; if the certificate contains data errors, request a corrected certificate prior to notarization; amounts may be released to the legal entity only after the certification of registration by the Mercantile Registry.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution of Notarial Deed of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public (Notario) duly admitted in the Notarial District of the prospective registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Execute the public deed (escritura de constitución) before the selected Spanish Notary; the deed includes by-laws (estatutos), share allotment, registered office election, appointment of the Sole Administrator, and the express statement of capital subscription and payment; all shareholder signatures must be identified; after reading, the deed is signed and a notarial first copy (copia autorizada) is issued for registry filing.
required_dossiers: Certificado negativo de denominación (name certificate)
Bank deposit certificate of EUR 3,000
Draft by-laws/estatutos signed by incorporators
Passports, DNIs, or NIE cards of all shareholders and the appointed administrator
NIE or CIF of non-Spanish incorporators, with fiscal representative details if required
Company purpose and EMR/HealthTech activity description for the deed
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Notary detects formal deficiencies (valuation, capacity, or validity of documents), issue an acta de subsanación (corrective instrument) or adjust the deed text; if any incorporated member is unable to attend, execute by representative with notarized power of attorney (poder especial).

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT) — Municipal/Territorial Tax Office or electronic office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Within the immediate post-notarization window, file Form 036 (declaración censal) together with a notarial copy of the deed of incorporation and the notary's certification of signature authenticity, requesting the provisional NIF (CIF); the provisional number is allocated while the deed is pending registration and must be used on all preliminary administrative filings.
required_dossiers: Notarial first copy (copia autorizada) of the incorporation deed
Form 036 — Census declaration for new legal entities
Tax Office appointment confirmation (cita previa) or electronic certificate submission
Identification of the Sole Administrator applying for the NIF
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If AEAT requires corrections, resubmit Form 036 within 10 business days; if the provisional NIF is withheld pending legal person verification, provide additional notarial certification; obtain 'acuse de recibo' as evidence of filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Mercantil Provincial (Provincial Mercantile Registry) of the province where the registered office is located
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Deliver to the Provincial Mercantile Registry the notarial first copy and one additional copy for certification; the Registrar reviews legal validity (calificación) of the deed and enters the company into the corporate registry upon payment of the applicable registration tariff; the definitive registration (inscripción) retroactively validates the company's juridical personality.
required_dossiers: Copia autorizada of the notarial deed of incorporation
Second notarial copy with the notary's signature and seal
Form 036 with provisional NIF allocated
Company name certificate
Bank deposit release instruction, if already provided
Proof of payment of registry fees (arancel del Registro Mercantil)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar issues a defect note (nota de calificación): rectify within the stated term by deed amendment or supplementary document; if the Registry falls into silent paralysis, request 'certificado de silencio administrativo positivo' or obtain judicial/administrative order from the Dirección General de los Registros y del Notariado (DGRN) to compel inscription.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Definitive NIF and Social Security Employer Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT) and Tesorería General de la Seguridad Social (TGSS)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon receipt of the certified registry inscription, return to AEAT to replace the provisional NIF with the definitive CIF and complete the census data; simultaneously register as employer at TGSS using the established operation code (clave patronal de ciberseguridad) to obtain a social security contribution account number for employees, including digital/remote employees if the EMR SaaS company hires Spanish personnel.
required_dossiers: Mercantile Registry inscription certificate (certificación de inscripción)
Provisional NIF certificate
Form 036 updated/definitive census filing
Employer social security registration application (Sistema RED / TA7)
Company deed and administrator NIE/passport
Corporate address and workplace classification data
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If definitive NIF is delayed, escalate with the aisle official heading the Registro/Unidad de Grandes Empresas; if TGSS rejects employer code application, correct the operation code and adjust economic activity classification (CNAE 6201).

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Municipal Activity License and Digital Services Compliance Filing
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: City Council (Ayuntamiento) of the registered office municipality; Diputación Provincial for rural settings
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the declaración responsable de inicio de actividad (responsible statement of business commencement) for the administrative category 'servicios de informática y tratamiento de datos' (CNAE 6201) covering the office address; attach building safety and fire protection evidence; for purely telematic SaaS operations, no industrial license is required, but the responsible statement must be submitted and municipal registry fees paid if applicable.
required_dossiers: Lease contract or title of registered office premises
Energy performance certificate (certificado de eficiencia energética) of the premise
Fire safety certificate of the building (certificado de protección contra incendios) issued by the competent fire service
Declaración responsable form of the municipality
Proof of payment of municipal fee (tasa por actividad)
Company CIF and administrator identification
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Ayuntamiento requests supplementary information or converts the declaration into a license proceeding, resubmit with additional structural reports; if the activity is deter mined to be 'clasificada' (clasified activity), initiate the licencia de actividad clasificada (trabajo de instalaciones) procedure; appeal tax assessments before the municipal grievance board (recurso de reposición) and then the administrative contentious jurisdiction.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Agencia Española de Medicamentos y Productos Sanitarios (AEMPS) for software qualifying as a medical device; Agencia Española de Protección de Datos (AEPD) for processing of health data and GDPR compliance; Ministerio de Sanidad for digital health software interoperability with public healthcare
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: European CE Marking under Regulation (EU) 2017/745 (MDR) for EMR software classified as a Class I/IIa medical device, including registration of the economic operator with AEMPS and issuance of a 'Declaración de Conformidad UE'; where the EMR is a non-device clinical workflow system, a 'Declaración responsable de producto digital sanitario' and AEPD data-protection-by-design registration apply

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Consejería de Medio Ambiente de la Comunidad Autónoma competente (regional environmental authority) in coordination with the Ayuntamiento
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt from full EIA — the activity is a wholly digital/software service (CNAE 6201) without manufacturing, combustion, or wastewater-generating processes; only an environmental communication (memoria ambiental simplificada) or municipal activity statement is required if the office installation exceeds the small-power-usage threshold
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Zero industrial discharges: no effluent beyond ordinary municipal sewer for sanitary facilities, subject to the local Ordenanza Municipal de Vertidos; indoor air and ventilation per Real Decreto 1027/2007 (RITE); data center and server rooms, if any, must comply with Directive 2014/34/EU equipment safety and refrigerant leakage standards; EMF (electromagnetic field) limits per CNE/UC 62311; no VOC or particulate emissions applicable to office hardware; e-waste disposal under Real Decreto 110/2015

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification for the office issued by the municipal fire brigade or a certified fire protection company (instalador autorizado) in accordance with CTE DB-SI; structural load and maintenance inspection of the building, verifying maximum office loading (< 200 kg/m²) and electrical load capacity for the EMR servers; workplace clearance and occupational risk prevention plan (plan de prevención de riesgos laborales, PRL) under Law 31/1995 administered through a licensed mutual insurance company (mutua colaboradora) or an accredited prevention service; if healthcare-telework employees are engaged, additional ergonomic workstation declaration and digital emergency protocol filings are required

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT); digital portal: Sede Electrónica (sede.agenciatributaria.gob.es)
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign entity without a Spanish establishment must obtain a non-resident NIF (Número de Identificación Fiscal) from AEAT, generally by filing Form 036/030 and appointing a Spanish tax representative where required. A foreign entity incorporating a Spanish Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada (SL) must execute the deed before a Spanish notary, obtain a provisional NIF, register in the Mercantile Registry, and thereafter obtain the definitive Spanish NIF/CIF. All taxable persons must also complete the Spanish census registration (Form 036/037) before commencing economic activity; electronic filing with an AEAT digital certificate is mandatory for most practitioners.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box election exists under Spanish law. A Spanish-resident SL is automatically treated as a separate corporate taxpayer subject to the Impuesto sobre Sociedades. Available electiive mechanisms include voluntary tax consolidation for Spanish groups, certain transparent statutory arrangements for UTE/Venture vehicles, and mandatory alignment with EU ATAD hybrid-mismatch rules; hybrid-mismatch outcomes are not elective.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No turnover threshold for VAT registration; any person conducting taxable economic activity in Spanish territory must register with AEAT from the first taxable transaction. Small-business special regimes (simplified regime and surcharge regime) may alter reporting mechanics but do not exempt the taxpayer from VAT registration.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: AEAT operates the Suministro Inmediato de Información (SII) system requiring designated large taxpayers and VAT groups to transmit invoice-level records to AEAT through certified XML/API services within four calendar days of relevant transactions. Royal Decree 1007/2023 implements mandatory B2B e-invoicing under the Ley Crea y Crece framework for all entrepreneurs and companies. Billing systems must comply with Verifactu integrity and traceability requirements, including QR and hash-based digital verification; no pre-clearance physical stamp is applied, but electronic records must be immediately available to AEAT upon audit demand.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of goods may be invoiced at 0% Spanish VAT only where goods are shown to have physically left the EU customs territory and are supported by valid customs export documentation, including the DUA/SAD movement reference number and proof of actual exit. Cross-border B2B services, including SaaS-based EMR services supplied to medical clinics established outside the EU, are not subject to Spanish VAT where the recipient is a taxable person located outside the EU and conditions of place-of-supply and business-identity evidence are met.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (DUA/SAD with MRN) showing exporter EORI and export destination
Bill of Lading, CMR, or Air Waybill evidencing physical dispatch and exit of goods from EU customs territory
Commercial invoice describing goods, terms of sale, client details, and authorized signatures
Proof of client establishment outside the EU (business registry extract, foreign VAT/passport evidence, or certificate from the client's tax authority)
Inward Remittance Certificate or equivalent bank FX/payment proof showing receipt of export proceeds
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: AEAT rigorously audits export substantiation, disguised domestic supplies, and fictitious export flows. If a zero-rated export is not sufficiently documented or the goods are not shown to have left the EU, AEAT retroactively recharacterizes the transaction as taxable at 21% and assesses the omitted VAT together with late-payment interest. Proportionate penalties under Law 58/2003 (LGT) range from 50% to 150% of the omitted tax where false or defective documentation is involved. Deliberate evasion using false export documents exceeding EUR 120,000 per fiscal year may also constitute criminal tax fraud under the Spanish Penal Code, with risk of imprisonment and cumulative administrative clawback within the applicable statutory limitation periods.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de España (Bank of Spain) is the national central bank and supervises payment-system and certain reporting obligations. The Spanish Treasury, through the Secretaría General del Tesoro y Financiación Internacional, administers applicable foreign-investment and external-transaction rules. Spain applies the European Union framework for capital movements and payments.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The euro is freely convertible. Under Article 63 of the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union, capital movements and payments are generally unrestricted within the EU and, subject to applicable EU and Spanish rules, with third countries. No general prior approval is required for an SL to receive foreign equity, make ordinary commercial payments, or remit dividends or other lawful distributions. Remittances remain subject to corporate-law distributable-profit and reserve requirements, withholding tax and treaty relief procedures, beneficial-ownership and sanctions screening, and the receiving bank's documentary review. Foreign investment declarations or statistical reporting may apply depending on the investor, transaction, amount, and current reporting rules; these should be assessed separately from any FX permission.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Spain has no general statutory deadline requiring export proceeds to be repatriated and no mandatory conversion or surrender ratio. Export receipts may be retained in foreign currency or abroad, subject to applicable tax, accounting, sanctions, and reporting rules. Cross-border payment and position reporting to Banco de España may apply under the external-transaction reporting framework, including the ETE reporting system, according to the applicable thresholds, frequency, and current instructions. Banks may request invoices, contracts, shipping or service-delivery evidence, and payment-purpose information; this is bank compliance practice, not a general mandatory FX conversion rule.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account; incorporation or capital-deposit account where required by the formation process and bank policy
Operational Account; incorporation or capital-deposit account where required by the formation process and bank policy
Operational Account; incorporation or capital-deposit account where required by the formation process and bank policy

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium to High for routine euro collections, payments, and FX if the provider is an appropriately authorized EU electronic-money institution or payment institution, or operates through a properly passported EU authorization. Verify authorization and permitted services in the relevant regulator register. An EMI account is not a bank deposit and generally does not provide deposit-guarantee protection; customer funds are subject to applicable safeguarding requirements. It should not be treated as a substitute for a Spanish bank account where a bank account, credit, cash services, or a specific statutory banking function is required. Provider country, supported currencies, safeguarding structure, limits, and acceptance of Spanish SLs must be confirmed before reliance.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Spanish law does not impose a universal requirement that directors attend a bank branch in person to open an SL account. Remote onboarding may be available at the institution's discretion, subject to reliable identity verification, beneficial-owner identification, source-of-funds review, and applicable anti-money-laundering requirements. A bank may require an in-person meeting, original or certified documents, Spanish tax identification numbers, or additional verification, particularly for non-resident directors or complex ownership structures. Obtain the bank's current onboarding requirements before incorporation funding.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident shareholder, director, or beneficial owner; layered or opaque ownership; nominee arrangements; or inconsistent ownership records
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide certified corporate extracts and constitutional documents for each ownership layer, a dated ownership chart identifying natural-person beneficial owners, passports and proof of residential address, Spanish NIE/NIF documentation where applicable, director and shareholder resolutions, and a clear explanation of control and business purpose. Obtain sworn translations or apostilles/legalizations where the bank requires them.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Large or unexplained initial equity funding, third-party funding, or transfers from a jurisdiction unrelated to the owners or business
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide the subscription or capital contribution documents, shareholder resolution, source-of-wealth and source-of-funds evidence, originating-account statements, transfer instructions, and an explanation linking the remitter to the shareholder and the Spanish SL. Ensure the remitter name and payment reference are consistent with the corporate records.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: EMR and health-data business model raises questions about regulated activity, customer funds, or access to sensitive health information
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide a concise product and revenue-flow description, customer and supplier contracts, an explanation that the SL supplies software rather than clinical care or payment services if accurate, applicable healthcare-sector or software compliance analysis, GDPR and Spanish data-protection documentation, and evidence of security and data-processing controls. Identify any separate licenses or registrations actually applicable to the operating model.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Expected cross-border receipts or payments lack a clear commercial rationale, or counterparties are in high-risk or sanctioned jurisdictions
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide executed customer and supplier contracts, invoices, service-delivery records, counterparty identification, transaction-flow diagrams, expected-volume forecasts, and sanctions-screening procedures. Document the business reason for each jurisdiction and retain payment and reconciliation records.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Inconsistency among the registered corporate name, NIF, registered address, tax residence, website, and payment-account details
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide the current Registro Mercantil extract, deed of incorporation and amendments, Spanish NIF certificate, registered-office evidence, tax-registration information, board or shareholder resolutions, and proof of operating address where requested. Use consistent legal-entity details across banks, processors, invoices, and contracts.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Fund equity through a transfer from the subscribing shareholder's identified account to the SL's account or the bank's designated incorporation/capital-deposit account, following the notary and bank's current formation procedures. Use an accurate reference identifying the SL, shareholder, and capital contribution; do not label a shareholder loan as share capital. Retain the subscription documents, corporate resolutions, bank advice, source-of-funds evidence, and proof of receipt. The bank may request a payment purpose or internal transaction code; Spain does not impose a universal FX purpose-code system or general capital-conversion requirement. Assess any applicable foreign-investment declaration and Banco de España external-transaction reporting separately, and verify current filing rules and deadlines with Spanish counsel or the competent authority.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Use SEPA Credit Transfer or SEPA Instant Credit Transfer for eligible euro payments within the scheme and provider limits. Use SWIFT customer credit transfers, commonly documented by an MT103 or its ISO 20022 equivalent, for non-SEPA or foreign-currency payments; provide accurate beneficiary, bank, invoice, contract, and payment-purpose information and select OUR, SHA, or BEN charges as agreed. For material or higher-risk trade settlements, a documentary commercial letter of credit may be arranged subject to bank credit approval and applicable UCP 600 terms; documentary collections may be used where commercially suitable. Reconcile payments to invoices and preserve records for accounting, tax, AML, and reporting purposes. Screen counterparties and transactions against applicable EU and Spanish sanctions.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable foreign-exchange forwards entered into with an authorized counterparty to hedge identifiable commercial exposures, subject to the counterparty's onboarding, credit, suitability, and documentation requirements.
Non-deliverable forwards where available and lawful for the relevant currency pair, subject to counterparty terms, product classification, and applicable EU financial-services requirements.

Foreign-exchange swaps and cross-currency swaps used for genuine treasury or commercial risk management, subject to counterparty approval, documentation, valuation, collateral, and applicable EMIR reporting, clearing, and risk-mitigation obligations.

FX options, where suitable and offered by an authorized counterparty, subject to product-governance, appropriateness or suitability requirements as applicable, and clear documentation of the hedged exposure.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within one month following approval by the General Shareholders' Meeting
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fines up to 300000 EUR and potential administrative strike-off proceedings

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: 20 March (or 30 March if using electronic signature)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Penalties for late filing up to 1000 EUR plus interest and tax surcharges

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within one month of any change in beneficial ownership or shareholding transfers
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fines up to 300000 EUR for non-compliance

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit if net turnover exceeds 2000000 EUR, total assets exceed 1000000 EUR, or average employees exceed 50 (any two criteria)
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Spanish GAAP (Plan General Contable) for most SL entities

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Annual confirmation of shareholding and beneficial ownership transfers required; updates to the UBO register must be notified to the Registro Mercantil within one month of changes
